title: Text: DET Dan Griesbaum ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I got a tip about some sort of Pride Pack ticket package...what do you know about that

Not a ton. I’m not really into group tickets and I’m not in their meetings but I hear there will be a package that includes a discounted ticket and pride T-shirt. Typical group promotion similar to things like CMU night or Italian-American night, etc
Ok...wondering if it’s going to be branded a Pride night
Yes definitely. T-shirt with their organizations typical marks that have been used at other venues etc
Ok, thanks for getting back to me. Yeah, I got more info on it
